description:
I won $1,000,000 from a MrBeast challenge! In this video I'll walk you through how to solve an initial set of 9 "puzzlehunt-style" puzzles that paved the way for the rest.

Also there's a random brain teaser in there, so if you solve it make sure leave a comment like "Oh! I got it!" or something. Let's call it Riddle #1.

0:00 Intro
2:52 Welcome to Phase 0
3:22 Puzzle 1 - Word search
7:31 Puzzle 2 - Sudoku
10:03 Puzzle 3 - TV Shows
13:08 Puzzle 4 - Rainbow Headache
14:39 Puzzle 5 - Pokemon
17:07 Puzzle 6 - Tents
19:59 Puzzle 7 - Dogs
23:50 Puzzle 8 - Pyramids
25:25 Puzzle 9 - Disdyakis Triacontrahedron
29:38 Helpful Tools

 @MrBeast  and  @salesforce  Million Dollar Puzzle:
https://mrbeast.salesforce.com

First 9 Puzzle Images:
https://www.reddit.com/r/MrBeast/comments/1qzsyhy

Crossword Solver: https://www.wordplays.com/crossword-solver
Word Finder: https://nutrimatic.org/
Puzzle Hunt Calendar: https://puzzlehuntcalendar.com/
More word tools: https://www.litscape.com/words_mammoth_censored/word_lists.html
Simon Tatham's Puzzle Games: https://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/~sgtatham/puzzles/

Join me on Twitch for puzzles and games every Thursday at 9:30 PM!
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/doctorxor
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/doctorxor

Outro music by 🥸 Mr. Manager 🥸
